Built to help local businesses grow

MCTY brings customers and trusted businesses together, starting in Uganda and designed to expand across East Africa.

✓

Verified business profiles

Every business applies first. The MCTY team privately reviews the details before approving a public listing.

↗

More ways to be discovered

Customers can search by category, town and service, explore products and contact businesses directly.

◎

Direct WhatsApp orders

Customers send their order to the business. Payment and fulfilment are arranged directly with the seller.

Marketplace growth opportunities

MCTY is free for customers and basic business listings are free during launch. Optional paid services can include featured placement, clearly labelled sponsored adverts, premium profile tools and marketing support. MCTY may introduce seller commissions only when completed orders can be reliably confirmed.

★

Featured placement

Businesses can promote offers and appear in highlighted discovery areas.

▦

Premium business tools

Enhanced profiles, richer catalogues and performance insights can be offered as paid upgrades.

＋

Marketing services

Product photography, campaign support and local promotion create additional revenue opportunities for MCTY.

Privacy and trust

Business applications and supporting documents are visible only to authorised MCTY administrators. A listing becomes public only after approval. Public profiles show the business contact details and catalogue needed by customers; private owner emails and review notes are not published. Customers arrange payment and delivery directly with each seller through WhatsApp.
